titre: TRIADE: Enabling LLM Agents to Write Native Code by Hand Under Signed-Intent Governance (Academic Edition v0.18.0) — manuscript, data tables, complete sources and verification evidence
description: The academic edition v0.18.0 of the TRIADE single-case study: a development protocol under which an LLM agent writes native x86-64, RISC-V and TLS 1.3 code directly as assembly notation, governed by signed layer-I specifications. This deposit contains the manuscript (29 pages), the consolidated data tables (the RQ2 instrumented round-trip measurements, the D204 campaign ledgers, the exact-trace constant-time replays, the M4 optimization measurements), the complete edition sources, the TLA+ models with the coverage lemma, the generative conformance campaign evidence, and the twelve-point verification report.
